title: How to Think — A Workshop with the Vice Chancellor
excerpt: A look back at the October 2024 workshop with Prof. Yusuf Mahbubul Islam, Ph.D., then Vice Chancellor of Southeast University.
author: Fazley Rabbi
cover_alt: Group photograph from the How to Think workshop at Southeast University, October 2024.
body:
## Learning to Ask Better Questions

In October 2024, I attended the **How to Think** workshop at Southeast University with **Prof. Yusuf Mahbubul Islam, Ph.D.**, the university’s Vice Chancellor at the time.

Faculty member **Tashreef Muhammad**, **Co-ordinator & Lecturer**, also joined the workshop.

The photographs capture the gathering and the questions documented during the session. The question boards organise ideas under **Definition**, **Information**, **Cause/Reason**, and **Process**—a useful structure for approaching a topic from different angles.

## Questions Across Disciplines

The displayed questions explore software development, cybersecurity, skill development, financial management, time management, and public speaking. They move from asking what something means to considering why it matters and how to approach it.

These photographs are a personal record of the workshop and the learning community at Southeast University.
